outputs.location: Section titled 'DATA AVAILABILITY' (immediately after the Statistical Analyses subsection of Methods)
outputs.issues: The DAS is present but not formatted per the required checklist: 1) Items are not presented as separate bullet points. 2) The three GEO accession numbers are listed without specifying which accession corresponds to scRNA-seq versus bulk RNA-seq (measurement type missing per accession). 3) Each dataset entry lacks an explicit short description of the measurement type next to the accession (e.g., 'scRNA-seq: GEO GSExxxxx'). 4) The Zenodo deposit is given with DOI/link but without a clear description of the data type(s) deposited. 5) Although resolvable links are provided, the statement should list each dataset on its own line/bullet including: measurement type, repository name/acronym, accession/DOI, and resolvable link.
